description: The file contains unit tests for WakeWordGate functionality in the SwabbleKit project, including tests for matching wake words, handling command extraction, multi-word triggers, and range indices.

classes.name: WakeWordGateTests
classes.description: A test suite for WakeWordGate features, containing multiple test cases.

methods.name: matchRequiresGapAfterTrigger
methods.description: Tests if the wake word trigger requires a minimum gap after it before proceeding.

methods.name: matchAllowsGapAndExtractsCommand
methods.description: Verifies that a command following the wake word trigger is correctly extracted when the gap condition is met.

methods.name: matchHandlesMultiWordTriggers
methods.description: Checks if multiple-word triggers are correctly recognized and processed.

methods.name: commandTextHandlesForeignRangeIndices
methods.description: Ensures command text extraction works correctly with ranges obtained from outside the transcript string.
